courier_records_location_check.name: courier_records_location_check
courier_records_location_check.value:
("courier_records"."latitude" is null) = ("courier_records"."longitude" is null)
        and ("courier_records"."latitude" is null) = ("courier_records"."location_accuracy_m" is null)
        and ("courier_records"."location_accuracy_m" is null or "courier_records"."location_accuracy_m" >= 0)

courier_records_received_by_check.name: courier_records_received_by_check
courier_records_received_by_check.value:
("courier_records"."kind" <> 'return' or "courier_records"."received_by_name" is not null)
        and ("courier_records"."kind" in ('delivery', 'return') or "courier_records"."received_by_name" is null)
        and ("courier_records"."received_by_name" is null or char_length("courier_records"."received_by_name") between 2 and 100)

courier_records_note_check.name: courier_records_note_check
courier_records_note_check.value:
("courier_records"."note" is null or char_length("courier_records"."note") between 5 and 200)
        and ("courier_records"."kind" <> 'problem' or "courier_records"."note" is not null)

courier_records_disbursement_check.name: courier_records_disbursement_check
courier_records_disbursement_check.value:
("courier_records"."kind" = 'disbursement') = ("courier_records"."disbursement_amount" is not null)
        and ("courier_records"."kind" = 'disbursement') = ("courier_records"."payee" is not null)
        and ("courier_records"."disbursement_amount" is null or "courier_records"."disbursement_amount" > 0)
        and ("courier_records"."payee" is null or char_length("courier_records"."payee") between 2 and 100)

courier_records_revert_check.name: courier_records_revert_check
courier_records_revert_check.value:
("courier_records"."reverted_at" is null) = ("courier_records"."reverted_by" is null)
        and ("courier_records"."reverted_at" is null) = ("courier_records"."revert_reason" is null)
        and ("courier_records"."revert_reason" is null or char_length("courier_records"."revert_reason") between 5 and 200)

record_photos_upload_check.name: record_photos_upload_check
record_photos_upload_check.value:
("record_photos"."uploaded_at" is null) = ("record_photos"."byte_size" is null)
        and ("record_photos"."byte_size" is null or "record_photos"."byte_size" between 1 and 1048576)

shipments_kind_fields_check.name: shipments_kind_fields_check
shipments_kind_fields_check.value:
case "shipments"."kind"
        when 'delivery' then "shipments"."recipient_name" is not null and "shipments"."recipient_phone" is not null
          and "shipments"."recipient_address" is not null and "shipments"."recipient_neighborhood_id" is not null
        when 'reverse_pickup' then "shipments"."recipient_name" is not null and "shipments"."recipient_phone" is not null
          and "shipments"."recipient_address" is not null and "shipments"."recipient_neighborhood_id" is not null
        when 'carrier_handoff' then "shipments"."recipient_neighborhood_id" is not null
          and "shipments"."carrier_id" is not null and "shipments"."destination_town" is not null
        when 'errand' then "shipments"."errand_description" is not null
      end

shipments_fee_override_check.name: shipments_fee_override_check
shipments_fee_override_check.value:
("shipments"."calculated_fee" is not null and "shipments"."fee" = "shipments"."calculated_fee")
        or "shipments"."fee_override_reason" is not null

shipments_reason_length_check.name: shipments_reason_length_check
shipments_reason_length_check.value:
("shipments"."fee_override_reason" is null or char_length("shipments"."fee_override_reason") between 5 and 200)
        and ("shipments"."void_reason" is null or char_length("shipments"."void_reason") between 5 and 200)

shipments_route_check.name: shipments_route_check
shipments_route_check.value:
("shipments"."status" <> 'registered' or "shipments"."route_id" is null)
        and ("shipments"."status" not in ('assigned', 'dispatched') or "shipments"."route_id" is not null)

shipments_window_check.name: shipments_window_check
shipments_window_check.value: "shipments"."window_start" is null or "shipments"."window_end" is null or "shipments"."window_start" < "shipments"."window_end"

route_tasks_problem_note_check.name: route_tasks_problem_note_check
route_tasks_problem_note_check.value: "route_tasks"."problem_note" is null or char_length("route_tasks"."problem_note") between 5 and 200

routes_courier_check.name: routes_courier_check
routes_courier_check.value: "routes"."status" not in ('in_progress', 'finished') or "routes"."courier_id" is not null

routes_cancel_reason_check.name: routes_cancel_reason_check
routes_cancel_reason_check.value:
("routes"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("routes"."cancel_reason" is not null)
        and ("routes"."cancel_reason" is null or char_length("routes"."cancel_reason") between 5 and 200)

company_settings_office_check.name: company_settings_office_check
company_settings_office_check.value:
("company_settings"."office_address" is null) = ("company_settings"."office_neighborhood_id" is null)
        and ("company_settings"."office_address" is null or char_length("company_settings"."office_address") between 5 and 200)
